name: HeroStalk
_intent: A villain's slow, menacing stalk: heavy deliberate heel-to-toe steps with almost no bob, chest carried slightly forward, shoulders rolling with each step, head steady and low (chin down, eyes forward), arms hanging loose with a small slow swing, hands relaxed. Weight, menace, confidence; never bouncy.
_reference: slow heavy walk: 2 steps per 1.6667 s, stance 66% of the cycle, root travel 2.5000 studs per cycle (1.5000 studs/s)

_walk.how: move the HumanoidRootPart forward at speed_studs_per_s while this loops
